title: Companion explicit account login
description: After local sign-out, enter another service credential using Save Auth or select a configured preset. Run this read-only check after the real login action. Validate launcher rotation on an existing device without ownership metadata, same-device rotation, and explicit login preservation: rotating a launcher-owned preset must change authentication, while a different expired launcher preset must not overwrite Save Auth.

connected.intent: Verify explicit login owns the live connection and can read the fleet.
